newsitem.title: USA: U.S. equity options volume sets record in October.
newsitem.headline: U.S. equity options volume sets record in October.

text.p: U.S. equity options volume set a monthly record in October with 19.33 million contracts traded, the Options Industry Council said Tuesday.
The October total topped the previous record of 18.70 million traded in January 1996.
The industry group said October volume rose by 16 percent from October 1995 and that average daily volume totalled 840,282 contracts.
Volume for the first 10 months of the year was 164.12 million contracts, up 13 percent from same period in 1995. --Derivatives desk, 312-408-8750/Email: derivatives@reuters.com
